title: vs.animation-set
description: One ESQ shared animation set as editable numbers and lists (Docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md §6.2.2, Content/AnimationSet.hpp). The game binds each actor to the first entry whose selector is its model's kind or its model number. Each bank is written as vs.actor-animation writes it; the native reader also checks what a schema cannot: element references, clip flags, event lengths and repeated selectors.

display_name.description: Optional informational name, not an identity or gameplay field.

source.description: The disc file the set came from, e.g. OBJ/E001.ESQ.

source_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the source file as extracted.

entries.description: The entries in the order the game searches them; the game holds at most 15.

selector.description: The model number or model kind the entry is for; 65535 would end the game's list.

texture_row.description: The effect texture row a model selected by its number uses; null for none (255 in the file).

bones.description: The bones each clip animates; it must match the models the entry binds.
